facts.claim: Celestyal Olympia (Celestyal Cruises): Entered service 1982; 37,670 GT; 1660 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 215 m length; ex-Song of America class.
MS Celestyal Olympia was a cruise ship owned by the Cyprus-based Celestyal Cruises, formerly Louis Cruise Lines.
In April 2012 she was named Louis Olympia after operating as the Thomson Destiny for Thomson Cruises.
She has since sailed for Louis Cruises as MS Louis Olympia, and as MS Celestyal Olympia since 2014.

catalogSpecs.description: Mid-sized ship specializing in Greek Islands and Eastern Mediterranean cruises.
